```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.align = "center", out.width = "100%")
required_packages <- c("dplyr", "tidyr", "ggplot2", "knitr", "rmarkdown")
missing <- required_packages[!vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(missing)) stop("Install required packages: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
})

# Discover one input per exposure. To restrict the report, set params$traits
# in the YAML header, e.g. ["sbp", "dbp"].
data_dir <- file.path("..", "data")
pattern <- "_pop_extract_common_snps_clumped_corrected\\.rds$"
all_files <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
if (!length(all_files)) stop("No matching exposure RDS files found in ", data_dir)
trait_names <- sub(pattern, "", basename(all_files))
files <- stats::setNames(all_files, trait_names)
if (!is.null(params$traits)) {
  requested <- as.character(unlist(params$traits))
  unknown <- setdiff(requested, names(files))
  if (length(unknown)) stop("Unknown trait(s): ", paste(unknown, collapse = ", "),
                            ". Available traits: ", paste(names(files), collapse = ", "))
  files <- files[requested]
}
populations <- c("AFR", "AMR", "EAS", "EUR", "SAS", "UGR")
alpha <- 0.05
```

# Analysis overview

The report analyses each matching exposure file in `../data/`. The significance threshold for multiple testing is calculated separately for each trait as `0.05 / number of testable SNPs`, where testable SNPs have valid estimates in at least two populations. The drug-target subset, when available, has its own denominator and threshold. The report plots population-specific estimates and 95% confidence intervals only for SNPs passing the corresponding Bonferroni threshold; therefore the SNPs shown can differ between traits. No SNP count or threshold is hard-coded.

```{r selected-inputs}
knitr::kable(data.frame(trait = names(files), input = basename(files)),
            caption = "Exposure datasets selected for analysis")
```

# Analysis functions

The original function names are retained. The analysis handles missing estimates and keeps each population's estimates correctly aligned when calculating per-population Q contributions.

```{r functions}
fixed_effects_meta_analysis <- function(beta_vec, se_vec) {
  if (length(beta_vec) != length(se_vec)) stop("beta_vec and se_vec must have equal lengths")
  keep <- is.finite(beta_vec) & is.finite(se_vec) & se_vec > 0
  beta_vec <- beta_vec[keep]
  se_vec <- se_vec[keep]
  n <- length(beta_vec)
  if (!n) return(list(beta = NA_real_, se = NA_real_, Q = NA_real_, Qdf = 0L,
                      Qpval = NA_real_, Qj = numeric(), Qjpval = numeric()))
  w <- 1 / se_vec^2
  beta <- sum(beta_vec * w) / sum(w)
  se <- sqrt(1 / sum(w))
  Qj <- w * (beta - beta_vec)^2
  Q <- sum(Qj)
  Qdf <- n - 1L
  Qpval <- if (Qdf > 0L) pchisq(Q, df = Qdf, lower.tail = FALSE) else NA_real_
  list(beta = beta, se = se, Q = Q, Qdf = Qdf, Qpval = Qpval,
       Qj = Qj, Qjpval = pchisq(Qj, df = 1, lower.tail = FALSE))
}

combine_data <- function(sslist) {
  if (!length(sslist)) stop("sslist must not be empty")
  if (is.null(names(sslist)) || any(names(sslist) == "")) stop("sslist must be a named list")
  pieces <- lapply(seq_along(sslist), function(i) {
    pop <- names(sslist)[i]
    dat <- sslist[[i]]
    absent <- setdiff(c("snpid", "beta", "se"), names(dat))
    if (length(absent)) stop("Population ", pop, " is missing: ", paste(absent, collapse = ", "))
    dat <- dat %>% select(snpid, beta, se) %>% filter(!is.na(snpid)) %>%
      distinct(snpid, .keep_all = TRUE)
    names(dat)[names(dat) == "beta"] <- paste0("beta_", pop)
    names(dat)[names(dat) == "se"] <- paste0("se_", pop)
    dat
  })
  Reduce(function(x, y) full_join(x, y, by = "snpid"), pieces)
}

heterogeneity_test <- function(sslist) {
  if (length(sslist) < 2L) stop("At least two population datasets are required")
  if (is.null(names(sslist)) || any(names(sslist) == "")) stop("sslist must be a named list")
  joined <- combine_data(sslist)
  beta_cols <- paste0("beta_", names(sslist))
  se_cols <- paste0("se_", names(sslist))
  beta_mat <- as.matrix(joined[, beta_cols, drop = FALSE])
  se_mat <- as.matrix(joined[, se_cols, drop = FALSE])
  analyses <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(joined)), function(i) {
    fixed_effects_meta_analysis(as.numeric(beta_mat[i, ]), as.numeric(se_mat[i, ]))
  })
  q <- tibble::tibble(
    snpid = joined$snpid,
    beta_fixed = vapply(analyses, `[[`, numeric(1), "beta"),
    se_fixed = vapply(analyses, `[[`, numeric(1), "se"),
    Q = vapply(analyses, `[[`, numeric(1), "Q"),
    Qdf = vapply(analyses, `[[`, integer(1), "Qdf"),
    Qpval = vapply(analyses, `[[`, numeric(1), "Qpval"),
    n_pop = rowSums(is.finite(beta_mat) & is.finite(se_mat) & se_mat > 0)
  )
  qj_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(analyses), ncol = length(sslist),
                   dimnames = list(NULL, names(sslist)))
  for (i in seq_along(analyses)) {
    valid <- is.finite(beta_mat[i, ]) & is.finite(se_mat[i, ]) & se_mat[i, ] > 0
    if (any(valid)) qj_mat[i, valid] <- analyses[[i]]$Qjpval
  }
  qj <- as_tibble(qj_mat)
  qj$snpid <- joined$snpid
  list(Q = q, Qj = qj)
}

expected_vs_observed_replication <- function(b_disc, b_rep, se_disc, se_rep, alpha) {
  if (!(length(b_disc) == length(b_rep) && length(b_disc) == length(se_disc) &&
        length(b_disc) == length(se_rep))) stop("All vectors must have equal lengths")
  if (length(alpha) != 1L || !is.finite(alpha) || alpha <= 0 || alpha >= 1)
    stop("alpha must be between 0 and 1")
  keep <- is.finite(b_disc) & is.finite(b_rep) & is.finite(se_disc) &
    is.finite(se_rep) & se_disc > 0 & se_rep > 0
  b_disc <- b_disc[keep]; b_rep <- b_rep[keep]
  se_disc <- se_disc[keep]; se_rep <- se_rep[keep]
  p_sign <- pnorm(-abs(b_disc) / se_disc) * pnorm(-abs(b_disc) / se_rep) +
    (1 - pnorm(-abs(b_disc) / se_disc)) * (1 - pnorm(-abs(b_disc) / se_rep))
  p_sig <- pnorm(-abs(b_disc) / se_rep + qnorm(alpha / 2)) +
    (1 - pnorm(abs(b_disc) / se_rep - qnorm(alpha / 2)))
  p_rep <- pnorm(abs(b_rep) / se_rep, lower.tail = FALSE)
  n <- length(b_disc)
  expected_sign <- sum(p_sign); observed_sign <- sum(sign(b_disc) == sign(b_rep))
  expected_sig <- sum(p_sig); observed_sig <- sum(p_rep < alpha)
  binom_p <- function(observed, expected) {
    if (n == 0L || expected <= 0 || expected >= n) NA_real_
    else binom.test(observed, n, expected / n)$p.value
  }
  list(
    res = tibble::tibble(nsnp = rep(n, 4), metric = c("Sign", "Sign", "P-value", "P-value"),
      datum = c("Expected", "Observed", "Expected", "Observed"),
      value = c(expected_sign, observed_sign, expected_sig, observed_sig),
      pdiff = c(NA_real_, binom_p(observed_sign, expected_sign), NA_real_,
                binom_p(observed_sig, expected_sig))),
    variants = tibble::tibble(expected_pval = p_sig, observed_pval = p_rep < alpha,
      replication_fail = p_sig > 0.95 & !(p_rep < alpha),
      expected_sign = p_sign, observed_sign = sign(b_disc) == sign(b_rep),
      sign_fail = p_sign > 0.95 & !(sign(b_disc) == sign(b_rep)))
  )
}

forest_plot <- function(sslist, snp) {
  dat <- bind_rows(lapply(names(sslist), function(pop) {
    x <- sslist[[pop]]
    x <- x[x$snpid == snp, , drop = FALSE]
    if (!nrow(x)) return(NULL)
    tibble::tibble(beta = x$beta[1], se = x$se[1], label = pop)
  }))
  if (!nrow(dat)) stop("SNP not found: ", snp)
  ggplot(dat, aes(x = beta, y = label)) + geom_point() +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = beta - 1.96 * se, xmax = beta + 1.96 * se), height = 0) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") +
    labs(x = "Effect estimate (95% CI)", y = "Population") + theme_bw()
}

# Draw population-specific estimates only for selected heterogeneous SNPs.
plot_heterogeneous_snps <- function(dat, hits, plot_title) {
  if (!nrow(hits)) {
    cat("No SNPs pass the Bonferroni threshold for this analysis.\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  plot_dat <- dat %>% semi_join(hits, by = "snpid") %>%
    mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = populations))
  ggplot(plot_dat, aes(x = beta, y = pop, colour = pop)) +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = beta - 1.96 * se, xmax = beta + 1.96 * se), height = 0) +
    geom_point() + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") +
    facet_wrap(vars(snpid), scales = "free_y") +
    labs(title = plot_title, x = "Effect estimate (95% CI)", y = "Population") +
    theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "none", strip.text = element_text(size = 8))
}
```

# Results by exposure

```{r analyse-traits, results='asis', fig.height=6}
for (trait in names(files)) {
  cat("\n## ", toupper(trait), "\n\n", sep = "")
  dat <- readRDS(files[[trait]])
  required <- c("snpid", "pop", "beta", "se")
  absent <- setdiff(required, names(dat))
  if (length(absent)) {
    cat("Skipped: required columns missing: ", paste(absent, collapse = ", "), "\n\n", sep = "")
    next
  }
  dat <- dat %>% filter(pop %in% populations, !is.na(snpid), is.finite(beta),
                        is.finite(se), se > 0) %>% arrange(pop, snpid) %>%
    distinct(pop, snpid, .keep_all = TRUE)
  pops <- populations[populations %in% unique(dat$pop)]
  if (length(pops) < 2L) {
    cat("Skipped: fewer than two configured populations have valid data.\n\n")
    next
  }
  sslist <- stats::setNames(lapply(pops, function(p) filter(dat, pop == p)), pops)
  result <- heterogeneity_test(sslist)
  n_tests <- sum(!is.na(result$Q$Qpval))
  mt_thres <- if (n_tests > 0L) alpha / n_tests else NA_real_
  result$Q <- result$Q %>% mutate(fdr = p.adjust(Qpval, method = "BH")) %>% arrange(Qpval)
  hits <- result$Q %>% filter(!is.na(Qpval), Qpval <= mt_thres)

  counts <- tibble::tibble(population = pops,
    variants = vapply(pops, function(p) sum(dat$pop == p), integer(1)))
  summary <- tibble::tibble(
    variants_tested = n_tests,
    bonferroni_threshold = mt_thres,
    nominal_Q_p_lt_0_05 = sum(result$Q$Qpval < alpha, na.rm = TRUE),
    bonferroni_significant = nrow(hits),
    FDR_lt_0_05 = sum(result$Q$fdr < alpha, na.rm = TRUE),
    smallest_Q_p = if (!n_tests) NA_real_ else min(result$Q$Qpval, na.rm = TRUE),
    smallest_FDR = if (all(is.na(result$Q$fdr))) NA_real_ else min(result$Q$fdr, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  cat("**Variant counts by population**\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(counts))
  cat("\n\n**Overall heterogeneity summary**\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(summary, digits = 5))
  cat("\n\n**SNPs passing this trait's Bonferroni threshold**\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(hits %>% select(snpid, n_pop, beta_fixed, se_fixed, Q, Qdf, Qpval, fdr), digits = 5))

  cat("\n\n**Population-specific estimates for Bonferroni-significant SNPs**\n\n")
  print(plot_heterogeneous_snps(dat, hits, paste0(toupper(trait), ": Bonferroni-significant heterogeneity SNPs")))

  cat("\n\n**Population-level Q contribution summary**\n\n")
  qj_long <- result$Qj %>% pivot_longer(-snpid, names_to = "population", values_to = "p") %>%
    filter(!is.na(p))
  qj_summary <- qj_long %>% group_by(population) %>%
    summarise(variants_with_estimate = n(),
      fraction_contribution_p_lt_0_05 = mean(p < alpha), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(fraction_contribution_p_lt_0_05))
  print(knitr::kable(qj_summary, digits = 3))

  if ("Drug" %in% names(dat)) {
    dat_drug <- dat %>% filter(!is.na(Drug), as.character(Drug) != "")
    drug_pops <- pops[vapply(pops, function(p) any(dat_drug$pop == p), logical(1))]
    if (nrow(dat_drug) && length(drug_pops) >= 2L) {
      drug_sslist <- stats::setNames(lapply(drug_pops, function(p) filter(dat_drug, pop == p)), drug_pops)
      drug_result <- heterogeneity_test(drug_sslist)
      n_drug_tests <- sum(!is.na(drug_result$Q$Qpval))
      drug_mt_thres <- if (n_drug_tests > 0L) alpha / n_drug_tests else NA_real_
      drug_result$Q <- drug_result$Q %>% mutate(fdr = p.adjust(Qpval, method = "BH"))
      drug_hits <- drug_result$Q %>% filter(!is.na(Qpval), Qpval <= drug_mt_thres)
      drug_map <- dat_drug %>% distinct(snpid, Drug)
      drug_summary <- drug_result$Q %>% left_join(drug_map, by = "snpid") %>%
        group_by(Drug) %>% summarise(n_snps = n_distinct(snpid),
          n_bonferroni_significant = n_distinct(snpid[snpid %in% drug_hits$snpid]),
          proportion_FDR_lt_0_05 = mean(fdr < alpha, na.rm = TRUE),
          median_Q_p = median(Qpval, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
        arrange(desc(n_bonferroni_significant), median_Q_p)
      cat("\n\n**Drug-target subset summary**\n\n")
      cat("Tests: ", n_drug_tests, "; Bonferroni threshold: ", signif(drug_mt_thres, 5),
          "; significant SNPs: ", nrow(drug_hits), "\n\n", sep = "")
      print(knitr::kable(drug_summary, digits = 4))
      cat("\n\n**Drug-target SNPs passing this subset's Bonferroni threshold**\n\n")
      print(knitr::kable(drug_hits %>% left_join(drug_map, by = "snpid") %>%
        select(snpid, Drug, n_pop, beta_fixed, se_fixed, Q, Qdf, Qpval, fdr), digits = 5))
      cat("\n\n**Population-specific estimates for drug-target Bonferroni hits**\n\n")
      print(plot_heterogeneous_snps(dat_drug, drug_hits,
        paste0(toupper(trait), ": drug-target Bonferroni-significant SNPs")))
    } else {
      cat("\n\nDrug-target analysis skipped: fewer than two populations have annotated variants.\n")
    }
  } else {
    cat("\n\nNo `Drug` annotation column; drug-target analysis not applicable.\n")
  }
  cat("\n\n---\n\n")
}
```

# Interpretation and reproducibility

Each exposure gets its own Bonferroni denominator, calculated from the number of SNP-level Q tests with valid estimates in at least two populations. The drug-target subset is corrected separately using its own number of testable SNPs. Effect plots show only variants passing the corresponding threshold; when no variant passes, the report states this explicitly. BH FDR is also provided as a complementary multiple-testing measure within each exposure. Per-population Q contribution p-values are descriptive and should not be treated as independent tests.
